scope: Bounded identity-only review: 52 leads, comprising 33 new flagged leads, all 12 normalized original-name collisions, and seven already-enrolled unflagged classics. Accept means identity research is sufficient for a qualified discovery label; it approves no starting rule, portable criterion, edition transfer, or deployment. No BoardGameGeek API, bulk dataset, or page content was fetched; identifiers come from Wikidata CC0 and one observed primary publisher hyperlink. Unknown original collision editions are not relabeled by this review. Additional review on 2026-09-27 qualifies the existing unflagged 315200/Q106948984 display name as Fantasy Realms: The Cursed Hoard using normalized official publisher context and a directly inspected primary BGG indexed numeric/title result. The preceding 52-lead scope and fetch-method statements describe that historical review; this addition imports no identity or rule. Additional identity-only review distinguishes 153 / Q1628545 as Hornochsen! (Take 5!) using separately preserved full Wikidata entity claims and normalized official AMIGO product/article 08940 evidence. The 53 earlier decisions and their historical scopes are retained; no starting-rule or edition transfer is authorized. Additional proposed identity-only review qualifies 200 / Q1344436 as Entdecker (Goldsieber) and 550 / Q646550 as Barbarossa (Klaus Teuber), using saved own normal Wikidata P2339 and complete CATAN author/licensing-company retrospective bodies. The preceding 54 decisions and their historical scopes are retained. Same-title peers 1334 and 72809 and Merchant of Venus 230/131646 remain excluded pending correspondence; no rule, alias, year, printing or edition transfer is authorized.
method: Read CC0 Wikidata item facts using wbgetentities and saved revisions, then corroborate accepted game/edition identities with original designer, publisher, federation, or association-hosted federation sources. Per-ID edition qualifiers are distinguished from item-wide publication years. Qualified display names prevent merging identical names. Holds retain unresolved ambiguity. Additional 315200 title review corroborates the saved P2339 identity binding with the official publisher expansion classification and qualified canonical BGG indexed item evidence. Failed destination opens and mixed Wikidata metadata remain explicit; no raw BGG HTTP, physical manual or printing correspondence is approved.
